title: Finalize Google Play Store packaging readiness for the IBN PWA (TWA)

requirements.text: Add a Digital Asset Links file for Trusted Web Activity verification by creating and serving a static file at `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` (i.e., `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json`) with clear placeholder values for package name and signing certificate fingerprint.
acceptanceCriteria: A file exists at `frontend/public/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and is served at `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` by the deployed app.
The JSON is valid and includes the standard `delegate_permission/common.handle_all_urls` relation with placeholders/instructions for `package_name` and `sha256_cert_fingerprints`.
No backend changes are required to serve the file (it is a static asset).

requirements.text: Update the in-app "Publish to Google Play Store" section to include a concrete checklist specifically for generating an Android package (AAB/APK) via Bubblewrap/PWABuilder and configuring Digital Asset Links, explicitly referencing the hosted path `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and the app manifest URL `{origin}/manifest.webmanifest`.

quotes: Do you want me to continue preparing it for Play Store packaging?

acceptanceCriteria: The Play Store publishing guide mentions `/.well-known/assetlinks.json` and explains that the values must be filled in after choosing a package name and signing key.
The guide explicitly references `{window.location.origin}/manifest.webmanifest` as the manifest input and keeps all user-facing text in English.
The section remains accessible from the existing landing page flow (no broken imports/routes).

requirements.text: Ensure Play Store listing assets are present as static files under `frontend/public/assets/generated/`, including app icons and a Play feature graphic, and reference them where appropriate (manifest for icons; guide text for feature graphic location).
acceptanceCriteria: The required images exist under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` with the exact filenames specified in this build request.
`frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest` continues to reference the 192x192 and 512x512 icons under `/assets/generated/`.
The Play Store guide references `/assets/generated/ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png` as the feature graphic location.

requirements.text: Update the service worker precache list to include the generated Play Store feature graphic so it is available offline alongside existing generated icons (without changing caching strategy).
acceptanceCriteria: Existing precache entries and network-first behavior remain intact.
The app still serves `offline.html` as a navigation fallback when offline.

constraints: Do not edit files under `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts`, `frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx`, `frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts`, `frontend/src/main.tsx`, or anything in `frontend/src/components/ui`.
Keep all backend logic in the single Motoko actor (`backend/main.mo`); only add a migration if persistent state schema changes are required (not expected for these changes).
nonGoals: Actually generating/signing an Android APK/AAB within the codebase or CI (this project will only provide the web assets and instructions needed for Bubblewrap/PWABuilder).
Integrating third-party authentication providers beyond Internet Identity.
Adding new payment providers or changing Stripe/bank transfer logic.

required: App icon with a bold "IBN" mark and warm orange/coral palette (ibn-app-icon.dim_512x512.png)
App icon variant for smaller launcher sizes, simplified and high-contrast (ibn-app-icon.dim_192x192.png)
Clean, modern Google Play feature graphic with warm orange/coral gradient (ibn-feature-graphic.dim_1024x500.png)
